subject: Request: scale-up addendum + accelerate onboarding timeline
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@neptune-analytics.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@neptune-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Request: expedited capacity increase + onboarding shift

Hi Sofia —

Quick note from our side: the upcoming model rollout has accelerated and we need to increase our committed capacity from 100 to 250 GPU-hours/month starting Dec 1, and move the onboarding kickoff up two weeks to Dec 6 (was Dec 20).

Can Redwood provide a one-page addendum or change order that:
- reflects the capacity increase and prorated fees for Dec
- updates the onboarding milestones and acceptance criteria in the SOW
- confirms whether the earlier date impacts the SLA or ramp credits

We have procurement and legal on standby (cc Claire). I attached a short deck and our procurement note (Neptune_Request_Details.pdf). Let us know the process and timing — need to get this over our legal team by Nov 22.

Thanks,
Liam
Head of Platform Partnerships
Neptune Analytics

Attachments: Neptune_Request_Details.pdf (summary deck, 1.4MB)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@neptune-analytics.com>
Cc: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@neptune-analytics.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: expedited capacity increase + onboarding shift

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline.

High level next steps from our side:
1) I will scope a short change order / addendum and route to Legal for redlines.
2) Jordan (contracts) will prepare a draft showing the prorated Dec fees and updated order form.
3) Kimberly (pricing) will confirm cost delta and any ramp-credit exceptions.

Jordan, can you please pull the existing order form (NEP-2026-058) and put together a one-page addendum draft? Goal is to have something to share with Neptune legal by Nov 18 so they can return it before Nov 22.

I'll also flag timeline risk for onboarding and loop in Markus for the MSA clause review.

Sofia
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed_change_outline.txt (1KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@neptune-analytics.com>, Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@neptune-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0500
Subject: Draft addendum (initial) — NEP capacity + onboarding shift

Folks — attaching an initial draft addendum for Neptune (NEP_Addendum_Draft.docx). Key points called out in the draft: 
- Increase committed capacity from 100 -> 250 GPU-hours/month, effective 2026-12-01.
- Prorated charge for December: 20 days at new rate; shown in fee table.
- Onboarding kickoff moved to 2026-12-06; milestone schedule condensed (two-week implementation plan).
- Temporary surge-burst allowance for first 30 days subject to fair-use clause.

Open items for internal decision: 
- Whether to provide onboarding acceleration fee waiver (we can offer one-time implementation credit of $7,500, subject to exec approval).
- Confirmation on SLA impact: engineering says we can meet the earlier timeline without changing the SLA, but Legal should confirm termination/ramp-credit language.

Kimberly, attaching a pricing delta sheet I put together (pricing_delta_sheet.csv). Please confirm numbers and whether you want to propose the credit.

Jordan
Senior Account Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: NEP_Addendum_Draft.docx, pricing_delta_sheet.csv

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@neptune-analytics.com>, Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@neptune-analytics@neptune-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Draft addendum (initial) — NEP capacity + onboarding shift

Thanks Jordan — numbers look right. Quick notes: 
- Monthly committed fee change: shows as +$36,000/month (net of committed discount). I recommend we present pricing both ways: (A) committed 250 with standard discount; (B) ramped commit (150 for 3 months then 250) in case they prefer a staged approach.
- I support a one-time implementation credit but suggest $5,000 instead of $7,500 to preserve margin.
- We need Legal to approve the clause around early ramp credits and any consequential liability if they cancel post-kickoff. Markus, can you confirm the MSA redline we should ask for (termination notice, prorated refunds, and language around force majeure for accelerated rollout)?

If Legal is okay, I'll prepare a clean pricing exhibit and we can send to Neptune legal.

Kimberly Park
Pricing Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@neptune-analytics.com>, Patricia Lane <patricia.lane@clarkandco-legal.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Draft addendum (initial) — NEP capacity + onboarding shift — Legal signoff pending

Team — I reviewed Jordan's draft and Kimberly's notes. Proposed legal edits (high level):
- Add explicit "Effective Date" clause and state that prorated charges for Dec will be invoiced on next billing cycle.
- Insert a limited liability carve-out for the first 30 days of accelerated onboarding tied to documented acceptance tests (we will require Neptune sign-off at each milestone).
- For termination: 30 days' notice for cancellation of the addendum; if cancelled after onboarding kickoff, Neptune is responsible for 50% of the remaining committed fees for the first 90 days.
- We will accept the $5,000 implementation credit subject to exec approval from Finance (Sofia to confirm).

Liam/Patricia — if these edits are acceptable, we will prepare a clean addendum and route to DocuSign. Expected internal signoff timeline: legal + sales by end of day Nov 22; Finance exec approval request sent today.

Markus Klein
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

---- Forwarded message ----
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@neptune-analytics.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@neptune-analytics.com>, Patricia Lane <patricia.lane@clarkandco-legal.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:50:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request: expedited capacity increase + onboarding shift

Sofia / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Our legal (Patricia) is ok with the commercial terms in principle but will review the proposed limited liability language. Please send the clean addendum and DocuSign link when ready.

Liam
